about: Dated maps of the Battle of Verdun the sector editor lays over the ground. Each is a scan kept in the asset library (.asset-cache/battle-maps, fetched by pnpm map:battle-maps), fitted to the ground by its control points: a pixel of the scan, and where that place lies in Lambert-93 metres. The frame is the part of the scan that is map, in pixels; what lies outside it (margins, the legend) is left off. Control points are read from the scan and from the LiDAR HD hillshade (the forts' moats, the destroyed villages' ruins and roads), not from present-day place coordinates, which can be 50 m or more off.

maps.title: Fronts français successifs au nord de Verdun, 21 au 26 février 1916
maps.source: Les armées françaises dans la Grande Guerre, tome IV, 1er volume, carte n° 16 (1:20 000)
